label: Request for information
description: Ask the customer for documents or details the investigation needs, with a date to reply by.

options.label: Receipt or invoice
options.text: a copy of the receipt, invoice or order confirmation for the payment

options.label: Proof of merchant contact
options.text: any correspondence with the merchant about this payment (emails, letters, chat transcripts) and their response

options.label: Delivery information
options.text: the expected delivery date, the delivery address and any tracking number

options.label: Cancellation information
options.text: a copy of the cancellation and the date it was sent to the merchant

options.label: Return information
options.text: proof that the item was returned, how it was returned, and the shipping receipt

options.label: Police report
options.text: the police report or its reference number

options.label: Other bank statement
options.text: a statement showing the same amount paid by another means

subject: We need a little more information about your dispute
paragraphs: We are looking into your dispute of the {{amount}} payment to {{merchant}}. To continue, we need the following from you:
Please reply by {{dueDate}} ({{days}} days from today). If we do not hear from you by then, we will decide the dispute on what we have.
